# Meal Mates AI

> Meal Mates AI is an intelligent nutritional planning and personalized dietary platform customized for Pakistani lifestyle, traditional cuisine, and fitness goals.

## Core Features & AI Systems

- [AI Meal Planner](https://mealmatesai.pages.dev/meal-planner): Multi-day combinatorial meal planner calibrating calories, macronutrients, and custom meal slots.
- [650+ Recipe Catalog](https://mealmatesai.pages.dev/recipes): Nutritional database of South Asian and Pakistani dishes with protein, carb, fat, and sodium breakdown.
- [Calorie & Macro Calculator](https://mealmatesai.pages.dev/calories-application): Biometric calculator estimating BMR, TDEE, and daily caloric deficit/surplus goals.
- [AI Nutritionist Chatbot](https://mealmatesai.pages.dev/chatbot): Real-time conversational LLM assistant providing dietary advice, ingredient swaps, and recipe insights.
- [Custom Category Planner](https://mealmatesai.pages.dev/custom-category): Allergy, restriction, and macro-targeted meal suggestions.
- [Grocery Store & Ingredients](https://mealmatesai.pages.dev/ingredients): Curated healthy food items and grocery discovery.
